# monitorable_server (Resource)

A server registered in Monitorable. Creating it returns the agent's API key and install command once; both are stored in state as sensitive values, so treat the state as a secret. Destroying it deletes the server and its metrics history. An imported server has no `agent_api_key`; rotate it in the dashboard or with `POST /v1/servers/{id}/agent-key:rotate` if the key is lost.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monitorable_server" "web" {
  name = "web-01"
}

# Install the agent on the host with the command the API returned when the
# server was created. install_command embeds the agent's API key; it is
# sensitive, so Terraform hides the provisioner's output. terraform_data is
# built into Terraform 1.4 and later, so no extra provider is needed.
resource "terraform_data" "web_agent" {
  triggers_replace = [monitorable_server.web.id]

  connection {
    type = "ssh"
    host = "203.0.113.10"
    user = "ubuntu"
  }

  # install_command is null for an imported server (and after a create whose
  # response was lost and recovered on retry), so this provisioner applies only
  # to servers this configuration created. For an imported server, rotate the
  # agent key in the dashboard and install the agent with the new key.
  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [monitorable_server.web.install_command]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name, 1 to 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace. Changing it renames the server in place.

### Read-Only

- `agent_api_key` (String, Sensitive) The agent's API key, returned once when the server is created. Null for an imported server, or when the create response was lost and replayed.
- `created_at` (String) When the server was created (RFC 3339).
- `created_via` (String) How the server was created, as the API reports it: `api` for a server this provider created.
- `id` (String) The server id, a decimal integer.
- `install_command` (String, Sensitive) The command that installs the agent on the host, exactly as the API returned it. It embeds `agent_api_key`. Null whenever `agent_api_key` is.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import monitorable_server.web 42
```
